newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yaohan Japan revises 96/97 group earnings estimate.
newsitem.headline: Yaohan Japan revises 96/97 group earnings estimate.

text.p: Yaohan Japan Corp said on Friday it had revised downward its group earnings estimate for the year to March 31, 1997, mainly due to a profit decline at its parent firm and losses at its domestic and overseas units.
Yaohan Japan, the flagship of the Yaohan international retailing group, now sees a group net loss of 26.85 billion yen in 1996/97, compared with an expected profit of 100 billion yen.
The company expects a group current loss of 5.11 billion yen, down from its previous 3.6 billion yen profit estimate.
Yaohan president Mitsumasa Wada said last month that the company would sell part of its overseas assets in order to revive its profits.
Yaohan is expected to announce its group earnings for 1996/97 on Monday.
